meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按预设规则切换助手的工作模式,让它照你设定的方式执行任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手用一套固定指令改变自己的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Switch the assistant into a preset work mode so it runs tasks your way
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to change how it works via a fixed set of directives

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 ultrawork 模式干活：本轮第一条可见输出固定是 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!，随后登记目标、开一个临时记事本记录计划与待办，并用真实环境验证（如 curl、浏览器、终端）留下证据。
howto.when: 当你明确要求进入 ultrawork 模式、且当前对话里还没有这份指令时触发；它会读取本文件并接管本次会话的执行流程。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式，帮我修这个 bug
say.note: 首行会输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式重构这个模块
say.note: 它会定级 LIGHT 或 HEAVY 并写计划

say.text: ultrawork 模式：先跑真实浏览器验证再改页面
say.note: 会截图留证再动下一处

howto.what_en: Claude runs in ultrawork mode: the first visible line is exactly ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!, then it registers a goal, opens a temp notepad for plan and todos, and proves work with real-surface evidence (curl, browser, terminal).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for ultrawork mode and the directive is not already in the conversation; it then takes over this session's execution flow.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix this bug
say_en.note: First line will be ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: Refactor this module in ultrawork mode
say_en.note: It picks LIGHT or HEAVY and writes a plan

say_en.text: Ultrawork mode: verify the page in a real browser first
say_en.note: Screenshots are captured before the next change
